miniProject.title: A grounded image-text branch with intervention evidence
miniProject.brief: Extend `lmlab` with a frozen vision encoder and a tested projector into your existing causal decoder. Keep retrieval, answer generation and image dependence separate so a fluent answer or lower loss cannot stand in for grounding. Run on CPU or your GPU without paid generation.
steps: Build the COCO manifest in `mm/` with caption and instruction parents, image-group splits, per-image rights, transformations, generator provenance and rejected-item counts. Plant renamed, re-encoded and caption-derived leaks; check hashes and reviewed lineage against known fixtures, quarantine affected groups and retain the audit.

Reuse TensorTonic Patchify and notebook Projector checks; add loop-oracle reconstruction, noncontiguous-input, dtype, parameter-count and zero-gate tests. Differential-test frozen-batch CLIP and SigLIP losses and gradients against OpenCLIP, reconciling reductions; retain resolution, token and FLOP budgets before training.

Connect frozen features through the projector to the causal decoder in `mm/`. Pass TensorTonic Multimodal RoPE coordinates, then independently test expanded labels, truncation, image ownership, padding, future-token isolation, serialization and cached-versus-full logits; retain failures. Optionally explain strided-video coordinates and audio/image generation's missing output contracts.

Check answer-only loss and gradients against a shifted-target oracle, optimizer membership and unchanged frozen tensors. Compare projector warmup plus bounded decoder updates against no warmup from shared state, across seeds with matched exposure and update budgets; retain compute differences and failed runs in `registry/`.

Build the original POPE random-negative scorer: test joins, missing and duplicate ids, strict parsing and confusion counts against hand-labeled fixtures. Reserve image groups before training; retain raw answers, parsed-subset metrics, all-item accuracy, yes ratio, invalids and coverage beside frozen retrieval and text-only baselines.

Evaluate intact, missing, corrupted and checked deranged-image conditions plus pixel-verified conflicting captions on identical held-out items. Predeclare object, text-in-image, spatial, counting, resolution and harmless embedded-instruction slices; check answers independently and retain image-group paired uncertainty separately from seed variation, including a negative or unresolved result.

Compare fixed retrieval candidates and generation budgets with length-matched blank features and a trained shuffled-pair control. Reconcile raw records with per-modality quality, coverage, token, latency and peak-memory tables in `reports/`; disclose unmatched compute, unknown pretraining overlap and distinctions between image dependence, grounding and safety.
deliverables: The `mm/` module, versioned COCO lineage, encoder and decoder identities, assembly metadata and independent correctness tests.
Matched staged-training and modality-control records in `registry/`, including failed attempts and retained negative evidence.
A `reports/` grounding dossier with original POPE answers, parser audits, retrieval and generation results, clustered uncertainty and modality costs.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Patchify a Batch of Images
checks.note: Reuse public patch cases; add reconstruction, noncontiguous-input and dtype checks.

checks.name: Modern LLM Notebook 29: Projector exercise
checks.note: Reuse the projector assertion, not the noncausal pipeline demo or post-normalization gate as an identity oracle.

checks.name: OpenCLIP release 3.3.0 loss oracle
checks.note: Compare losses and feature, multiplier and bias gradients with normalized features and explicitly aligned reductions.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Assign Multimodal RoPE Coordinates
checks.note: Coordinate cases do not replace expanded-sequence, causal-mask or cached-decoding tests.

checks.name: Original POPE COCO random-negative questions at pinned commit
checks.note: Use held-out image groups and your audited parser; disclose departures from the original evaluator and limited subset scope.

rubric.pass: Your audit catches all planted leak types, quarantines their source groups and preserves per-image rights, answer evidence, generator unknowns and rejection counts.
rubric.strong: A rebuilt manifest reproduces splits and exposure counts; reviewed near-duplicate candidates distinguish semantic similarity from shared pixels without claiming clean pretraining.

rubric.pass: Your loop, gradient and OpenCLIP oracles pass before training; assembly, freeze boundaries, parameter counts, serialization and cached decoding pass independent regression tests.
rubric.strong: Planted mask, reduction, image-ownership and stale-feature defects fail their intended checks; actual optimizer and activation storage explain the resource ledger.

rubric.pass: Your hand-checked scorer preserves invalids and ids; retrieval, answer quality and modality interventions retain fixed budgets, clustered uncertainty, seed variation and negative evidence.
rubric.strong: Separate inference interventions and trained shuffled-pair controls isolate language shortcuts, resolution and extra-context explanations; no benchmark outcome is presented as general multimodal safety.

miniProject.feedsInto: The image-text module, modality failures, lineage and cost records feed Alignment, Safety and Release's threat model and the capstone's bounded module; Research-Scale Integration joins their identities and reproduces the supported claims.
